clayDecision: User explicitly approved Codex/reference-view.png: Yes this one is good. Preserve its geometry as the texture baseline. Earlier fidelity-failed records remain historical.

stone.appearance: Dark warm gray fractured rock, muted cream mineral flecks, small pits, restrained dusty edge wear; variation follows each stone without painted lighting
stone.detail: Normal map only for grain and pits; preserve approved silhouettes

mortar.appearance: Charcoal gray joints, darker than stones, soot concentrated inside hearth

iron.appearance: Dark forged iron, patchy brown oxidation, worn silver-gray contact edges, restrained scratches; rivets and plates share metal family
iron.metallic: Clean iron 1; oxidized patches 0, interpolated by rust mask

leather.appearance: Deep warm brown bellows leather with fine grain, crease darkening and rubbed raised surfaces

wood.appearance: Weathered dark brown frame and boards, grain aligned along each member, worn ends; hardware uses iron

crucible.appearance: Heat-darkened rough refractory exterior, pale worn rim, charcoal inner bowl; retaining bands use iron

coal.appearance: Charcoal lumps, gray ash and localized orange-red hot fissures
coal.emission: Localized to existing fuel geometry, never entire hearth walls

execution: Copy exact approved blend and verify source hash before modification.
Map every visible mesh to a material role using source component records; fail on unmapped parts.
Create UVs and procedural source materials with detail scales tied to component dimensions.
Render initial material comparison with approved camera and studio lighting; evaluate palette and surface response.
Bake base color, tangent normal, roughness, metallic and emission to 2048px maps; color maps sRGB, data maps linear.
Reopen baked scene and compare against procedural source. Inspect seams, missing islands and material role boundaries.
Only after Blender material review, import verified asset and inspect actual Unity render and material channels.
validation: No geometry edits during texture stage
No projected reference image or baked studio shadows
No claim of exact fidelity from a bake receipt
Preserve frozen comparison candidates and original concepts
limitations: Clay approval permits material work but does not prove textured fidelity or game readiness. Hidden surfaces are inferred. Final palette, wear and lighting require actual rendered inspection.
